prefix.description: SEL-787 Transformer Protection Relay base unit (vertical chassis, user-configurable labels)

part_number.note: 20-digit Model Option Table string per WI-7257 (SEL-787 base unit). Calibrated against real relay part numbers read from the SEL-787 instruction manual CID/PARTNO blocks (e.g. 0787EX1B0X0X7585023X). Physical string order: prefix(1-4), firmware(5), reserved X(6), Slot A power supply(7-8), Slot C(9-10), Slot D(11-12), Slot E(13-14), Slot Z 6 ACI(15-16), Slot B processor(17), Slot B Ethernet(18), Slot B protocols(19), conformal coat(20). The Slot B communication digits sit at the TAIL of the string (17-19), not adjacent to Slot A as the doc's section order suggests. Slot C/D/E positions are corroborated by the i7048.E drawing layers (positions 9/11/13); the i7048 SLOT_B ethernet layer anchor at position 15 is a MIS-ANCHOR — real part numbers place the Slot Z 6 ACI card at 15-16 (e.g. 85 = 5 A/5 A). The i7321/i7322-family drawings (positions 8/10/12/14/16) belong to the 21-digit SEL-787-2/-3/-4 variant (WI-9842), a different string.

positions.label: Firmware / Model Option
positions.note: Selects the differential/measurement model. Firmware 1 forces a Neutral ACI card in Slot E (first digit A); firmware E forces a Neutral ACI + 3-phase voltage card in Slot E (first digit 7). SEL-787-0 provides 3 expansion slots (C, D, E); SEL-787-1 and SEL-787-E provide 2 (C, D) with the third occupied by the neutral current/voltage card.

options.1: Standard Two-Winding Transformer Current Differential with REF
options.E: Standard with REF plus Voltage Sensing, V/Hz Element, Over/Under Voltage, Frequency, and Power Elements

positions.label: Reserved
positions.note: Fixed placeholder digit; always 'X' in observed part numbers.

positions.label: Slot A Power Supply with I/O (2 DI, 3 DO)
positions.note: First digit = power-supply voltage, second digit = digital-input voltage. Base-unit power-supply card (SELECT PSIO) includes 2 DI and 3 DO.

positions.label: Slot C I/O card | DI voltage
positions.note: First digit = card type, second digit = digital-input voltage (X/0 = none). Only one 3 DI/4 DO/1 AO and one 4 AI/4 AO card per chassis. Serial Communications card is A0.

options.6: 4 AI / 4 AO (±20 mA or ±10 V, jumper selectable)
options.D: 4 DI / 3 DO Electromechanical (2 Form C, 1 Form B)

positions.label: Slot D I/O card | DI voltage
positions.note: First digit = card type, second digit = digital-input voltage (X = none). 10 RTD Input card (9X) is available in Slot D.

options.6: 4 AI / 4 AO (±20 mA or ±10 V, jumper selectable)
options.D: 4 DI / 3 DO Electromechanical (2 Form C, 1 Form B)

positions.label: Slot E I/O card | DI voltage / neutral rating
positions.note: First digit = card type, second digit = DI voltage for I/O cards or neutral current rating (1 = 1 A, 5 = 5 A) for the A/7 current-input cards. Firmware-coupled: firmware 1 -> card A (1 ACI), firmware E -> card 7 (1 ACI / 3 AVI); firmware 0 allows any standard I/O card.

options.6: 4 AI / 4 AO (±20 mA or ±10 V, jumper selectable)
options.7: Neutral AC Current Input / 3-Phase AC Voltage 300 Vac (1 ACI / 3 AVI) [requires firmware E]
options.D: 4 DI / 3 DO Electromechanical (2 Form C, 1 Form B)
options.A: Neutral AC Current Input (1 ACI) [requires firmware 1]

positions.label: Slot Z 6 AC Current Input (6 ACI)
positions.note: Base-unit 6-phase AC current input card; first digit fixed at 8. Real part numbers place this card at positions 15-16 (e.g. 85). The i7321/i7322-family drawings anchor SLOT_Z at position 16 because they describe the 21-digit SEL-787-2/-3/-4 variant, not this base string.

options.81: 6 AC Current Input: 1 A Winding 1, 1 A Winding 2
options.82: 6 AC Current Input: 1 A Winding 1, 5 A Winding 2
options.85: 6 AC Current Input: 5 A Winding 1, 5 A Winding 2

positions.label: Slot B Processor Board (CPU/COM)
positions.note: Single option: all Slot B configurations include EIA-232 front, IRIG-B, multimode ST fiber-optic serial, SEL ASCII/Compressed ASCII, Fast Meter/Operate/Message, MIRRORED BITS, and Modbus RTU.

options.0: EIA-232 front, IRIG-B, Fiber-Optic Serial Multimode ST, SEL ASCII, Modbus RTU

options.4: Single 100Base-FX MM LC Ethernet, EIA-232 rear
options.8: Dual 100Base-FX MM LC Ethernet, EIA-232 rear

options.3: Standard plus DNP3 plus IEC 61850 (requires Ethernet)

positions.label: Conformal Coat
positions.note: Doc codes 0/1. Observed relay part numbers report 'X' in this position for standard (uncoated) boards, so X is treated as None.
